summary: Bundled SDK with generic POST patterns; no evidence of installer harm
details: The package ships a minified bundle (dist/index.js) that contains multiple HTTP POST call sites and a token matching 'dyndns' within the bundle. These matches are keyword co-occurrences in a large bundled SDK and are not tied by any traced evidence to a hardcoded attacker C2, credential read, environment scraping, install-time execution, or exfiltration mechanism. No lifecycle scripts, top-level import side effects, credential-path reads (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc), env-var scraping, or fetch-and-execute patterns are cited. The package is a semantic indexer SDK scoped under a known publisher scope (@magda), and the observed patterns are consistent with normal HTTP client usage inside an SDK bundle.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
